remarks:
Welcome to 20 Nieman Drive. This beautiful all-brick home is located in the highly ranked school district of Orchard Park.  This split-level/ ranch  home has 3 ample sized bedrooms located 3 steps up to the second floor w/ 2 baths and a 4th bedroom or office located on the lower floor.  Enjoy the covered front porch and a screened in patio room off the back of the house overlooking the private backyard.  Step inside to a spacious  open floor plan featuring  cathedral ceilings, a cozy wood burning fireplace.  The newly  remodeled kitchen is truly the heart of the home, offering  solid  dark wood cabinetry, a large pantry cabinet, lots of  lighting,  Granite & Marble countertops, and an oversized kitchen island that is perfect for entertaining or everyday living.  Hestan stove,refrigerator and dishwasher appliances. Hickory hardwood flooring in the kitchen and Maple hardwood in the living room and dining area. A large bay window fills the home w/ natural light and overlooks the wooded backyard.  Large 2 car garage has access to both kitchen and basement. 
The lower level offers a cozy family room w/ a second fireplace, a fourth bedroom/and or office room with a full door access to the backyard. With the added bedroom, there is extra square feet added to the home. The owner measured. Very large basement with abundant storage.. Newer updates: kitchen, bathrooms, most windows, front door, slider patio door. electrical service and roof.  Move in ready, ideally located near village, Highmark Stadium, 219 and O.P. Havest Hilla Golf Course.
